clause: Interop recovery/diagnostics fail-closed + receipt audit surface [STU-IO-012]

scope.summary: Implement fail-closed import/export recovery: malformed, truncated, version-newer, or password/DRM-protected inputs MUST produce a deterministic diagnostic receipt (what failed, at which decode stage, safe fallback) and MUST leave existing authority unchanged (no silent partial/corrupt write). Every lossy or transforming operation — rasterization, baking, preservation-blob, text-rasterized-on-export, unsupported-feature drop — MUST emit an operator- and model-visible receipt at the time it occurs. Receipts are the interop-fidelity audit surface, EventLedger-bound per [STU-ARC-003].
expected_tests: negative: malformed/truncated/version-newer/password-protected input -> diagnostic receipt + authority unchanged (no partial write)
test: each lossy op (rasterize/bake/blob/text-rasterize/drop) emits a time-of-op receipt
acceptance_criteria_original: import/export fails closed with receipt; every lossy op receipted; receipts ledger-bound

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-IO-012] Import/export MUST fail closed and never write a silent partial or corrupt result to authority: - Malformed, truncated, version-newer, or password/DRM-protected inputs MUST produce a deterministic diagnostic receipt (what failed, at which decode stage, and the safe fallback) and MUST leave existing authority unchanged. - Every lossy or transforming operation — rasterization, baking, preservation-blob, text-rasterized-on-export, and unsupported-feature drop — MUST emit an operator- and model-visible receipt at the time it occurs. - Receipts are the audit surface for interop fidelity and are EventLedger-bound per [STU-ARC-003]. ### 9. Provider / cloud formats and account-gated surfaces

[STU-ARC-003] EventLedger event variants for Studio MUST follow the canonical addition list in 14.23. The Studio module adds variants to `KernelEventType` in `kernel/mod.rs` (wire format `STUDIO_*` SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE via `as_str()`) with dot-namespaced lowercase `event_family` constants (`studio.document`, `studio.raster`, `studio.vector`, `studio.layout`, `studio.typography`, `studio.color`, `studio.effect`, `studio.export`, `studio.history`, `studio.proposal`, `studio.design_system`, `studio.prototype`), and registers every variant in `required_first_slice_events()`. Every `WriteContext` carries a `KernelActor` variant so model-authored Studio rows are distinguishable from operator rows in the audit log.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
